authorInfo.bio: Josh Billings (1818–1885) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Hiz Sayings" by Josh Billings is a collection of humorous essays and observations written in the late 19th century. This work showcases the author's unique style, blending wit and wisdom as he explores various topics through the lens of everyday life, often with tongue-in-cheek commentary and a distinctive phonetic spelling.
